subject: Packaging admin activity logs & snapshot for SOC 2 / SIG review
messages:
From: Danielle Park <dpark@acmehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Hooper <mhooper@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: admin activity log package for upcoming SOC 2 review

Hi Karthik,

We’re prepping for Acme Health’s SOC 2 evidence window next month and the auditor asked for a discrete bundle of admin activity logs covering the last 12 months plus a point-in-time snapshot for the control period (2025-03-01 to 2026-02-28). Specifically they want: a) canonical event schema (what fields are included), b) retention dates, c) export in NDJSON or CSV, and d) an integrity checksum for the snapshot.

Can Redwood provide a packaged deliverable (logs + manifest + signed hash) and an explanation of which admin actions are captured (create/update/delete role, permission grants/revokes, API key ops, user sessions, authentication failures, policy changes, console access, export events, etc.)? Also curious about default retention and options for extending retention for compliance customers.

We’re on a tight timeline — would like to receive the package or a delivery plan by 2026-03-05 if possible.

Thanks,
Danielle Park
Security Manager, Acme Health

Attachment: acme_s3_destination_and_requirements.pdf (attachment stub)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Park <dpark@acmehealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity log package for upcoming SOC 2 review

Hi Danielle —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can produce a packaged snapshot and manifest that meets SOC 2 auditor expectations. High-level points: 

- Scope: our admin activity logs cover authentication events (success/failure), API key lifecycle (create/rotate/revoke), user & role management (create/update/delete), RBAC changes, console/admin UI actions (policy edits, model pinning, rollout ops), export/download events, and system-level config changes.
- Schema: we have a canonical event schema (attached) with fields: timestamp, event_id, actor_id (internal user), actor_role, action_type, target_type, target_id, request_id, src_ip, user_agent, outcome, model_id (if applicable), seq_index, and raw_payload.
- Retention: default retention for hosted customers is 90 days. For Dedicated/Enterprise we support configurable retention up to 7 years under contractual agreement. Retention >1 year requires archived storage and is a billable add-on.
- Export formats: NDJSON (preferred for auditor tooling), CSV (flat), and signed tarballs containing logs + manifest + SHA256 checksums. We can also deliver directly to your S3 bucket via a presigned, encrypted upload or push to your SIEM via syslog/HTTPS integration.
- Snapshot integrity: snapshot manifest will include per-file SHA256 + overall manifest signature (we sign with our key and provide public cert for auditor verification).

I’m looping Priyom and Laura to scope the package and confirm delivery steps. We should confirm exact time range, preferred format (NDJSON vs CSV), and destination (S3 / secure share / HubSpot link).

Plan: Priyom — can you prepare the schema + sample export (last 30 days) and the playbook for manifest creation? Laura — can you confirm entitlement/contract for extended retention and S3 delivery? I’ll coordinate with Acme to confirm destination and timeline.

- Karthik

Attachment: redwood_admin_activity_schema_v2.csv (stub)

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Danielle Park <dpark@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity log package for upcoming SOC 2 review

Hi all —

Attached is the schema CSV and a 30-day sample NDJSON export (redacted) I generated to show field names and typical event volume. A couple implementation notes auditors often ask for: 

- Timestamps: exported in ISO-8601 UTC (we include both event_ts and ingested_ts).
- Actor identity: we include internal user_id and email when available; system/service actions are tagged with service principal ids.
- Prompt/model fields: for actions that touch model serving (model pin/unpin, rollout changes) we include model_id and model_version in the event. We do NOT include prompt text in admin activity logs by default (that lives in request logs / data plane).
- Filtering: exports can be filtered by action_type, actor, date range, and target_type. For the snapshot we recommend provide full unfiltered admin events for the period requested.
- Volume estimate: for a customer of Acme’s size, admin activity average ~6–10k events/month; full 12-month bundle should be manageable (we’ll provide a size estimate).

I’ve stubbed a playbook (SOC2 snapshot) that describes how we compose the tarball: ndjson files per month, manifest.json (schema + per-file checksums), and signed.manifest.sig (SHA256 signed).

Attachment: sample_admin_30days.ndjson (redacted, stub)

Happy to generate the full package once destination and format confirmed.

— Priyom

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Danielle Park <dpark@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity log package for upcoming SOC 2 review

Danielle —

Contract/entitlement check: Acme Health is on an enterprise plan that includes up to 3 years retention by default and archival options beyond that. Extended retention to 7 years is available as a negotiated add-on; legal usually asks for an amendment. For the March delivery window we can enable a temporary extended retention snapshot if you need preserved copies beyond 90 days while audit is ongoing.

Delivery options: 
- Preferred: S3 push to your encrypted bucket (we push encrypted tarballs to a presigned S3 upload)
- Alternate: secure transfer link on our drive (short-lived, auditor access)
- For SIEM ingestion customers we can also stream admin events via HTTPS to the collector, but that’s not typical for snapshot evidence.

I’ll raise a scope ticket for the retention change and send a one-off invoice confirmation for archival storage if Acme wants the 7-year option.

— Laura

Attachment: soc2_snapshot_playbook.pdf (stub)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Park <dpark@acmehealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity log package for upcoming SOC 2 review

Danielle —

Action items / delivery plan: 
1) Confirm time range: 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-02-28T23:59:59Z (please confirm).
2) Format: NDJSON preferred (auditor-compatible). If you must have CSV we’ll provide additionally (note: CSV flattens nested payloads).
3) Destination: please confirm S3 bucket ARN or we’ll provide a presigned upload link.
4) Integrity: we will deliver a signed manifest + per-file SHA256 checksums. We’ll provide our public verification cert and a short verification script auditors can run.
5) ETA: initial manifest + 30-day sample by EOD 2026-03-04; full 12-month tarball by 2026-03-09, delivered to confirmed destination.

If that timeline works, I’ll mark the ticket and start the export job. Thanks for the clear scope — we’ll make sure the package includes everything the auditor expects (schema, manifest, signed checksums, and a brief readme explaining fields).

— Karthik
